list.title: Sessions
list.name: Session name
list.myAssignmentHint: You facilitate a group in this session.

actions.openConfirmBody: Its details lock once it opens.
actions.closeConfirmBody: The session becomes read-only after closing. You can still open it again.

actionHints.editOpened: This session is open. Its details are locked.
actionHints.closeDraft: Open the session before closing it.
actionHints.deleteOpened: Open sessions can't be deleted. Close it first.
actionHints.busy: Another action is still running. Wait for it to finish.

gate.title: {{name}} can't open yet
gate.noGroups: Add at least one group with one child before opening the session.
gate.emptyGroups: These groups have no children yet. Add children to each one before the session opens.
gate.noGroupsFinished: This session closed with no groups, so it can't be reopened. Delete it and create a new session.
gate.emptyGroupsFinished: This session closed with empty groups, so it can't be reopened. Delete it and create a new session.
gate.ownerMissing: These groups have no active facilitator. Assign one before the session opens.
gate.hint: Fix its groups on the detail page, then open it again.
gate.hintFinished: The roster is frozen after close. Open the details to delete this session.

wizard.title: Create a new session
wizard.pickProgram: Pick the program this session will run.

form.endTimeHint: Blank = 24 hours. The end time must be after the start time.
form.descriptionHint: Shown on the session page and in reports.
form.childrenHint: A child may belong to only one group within the same session.

errors.name: The session name is required.
errors.endTime: The end time must be after the start time.

detail.deleteCounts: {{rapor}} sent reports, {{foto}} photos, and {{link}} active links will die with it. This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteScope: {{groups}} groups, {{members}} members, and {{topics}} assessment topics are wiped too.
detail.locked: The session is locked for this change.
detail.noGroups: No groups yet. Add a group before opening the session.
detail.noGroupsLocked: No groups were added before this session left draft.
detail.noGroupsLockedHint: It can't be reopened. Delete the session and create a new one.
detail.openBlockedNoGroups: No groups yet. Add a group with at least one child before opening the session.
detail.openBlockedEmptyGroups: These groups have no children yet: {{groups}}. Add children before opening the session.
detail.openBlockedOwnerMissing: These groups have no active facilitator: {{groups}}. Assign one before opening the session.
detail.openBlockedNoGroupsFinished: This closed session has no groups, so it can't be reopened. Delete it and create a new session.
detail.openBlockedEmptyGroupsFinished: This closed session has empty groups ({{groups}}), so it can't be reopened. Delete it and create a new session.

group.deleteCounts: {{members}} members and all of their session data are wiped too.
group.deleteScope: {{assessments}} assessments, {{consent}} consent links, and {{links}} report/gallery links of this group's members die with it.
group.removeWarn: This child's assessments, photos, narratives, missions, and consent in this session are wiped too.
group.ownerInactive: The facilitator must be active in this school.
group.emptyLocked: No members — the roster was frozen when the session left draft.
group.ownerOptional: A facilitator is required before the session opens.
group.ownerRequired: Assign a replacement facilitator. The current one can't be cleared after draft.
group.ownerLockedHint: The facilitator can be replaced but not cleared after the session leaves draft.
group.rosterLockedOpened: Groups and participants are locked while the session is open. You can still rename a group or replace its facilitator.
group.rosterLockedFinished: Groups and participants are locked after the session closes. You can still rename a group or replace its facilitator.

copy.title: Copy grades from Session {{name}}?
copy.hint: Only empty cells are filled. Existing data is kept.
copy.skipped: Skipped (already filled) — assessments {{assessments}}, narratives {{narratives}}, missions {{missions}}, photos {{photos}}.
copy.inProgress: The copy is still running on the server. Reopen if the result is not shown yet.

gallery.title: Gallery

capture.title: Camera
capture.intro: A 9:16 or 16:9 canvas. The camera fills it with a full crop and frames fit without stretching.
capture.failed: The camera could not take the photo.
capture.reviewHint: Frame and mirror can still change before saving.
capture.ratioHint: {{ratio}} canvas — preview and result use a full crop.
capture.noFrames: No frames for this program yet.
capture.frameError: The frame could not load — the photo will be saved without it.
capture.frameHint: The frame is fused into the photo when saved.
capture.deniedHint: Camera unavailable. Upload an image to use the same flow.
capture.unavailableHint: Another app may be using the camera. Close it, then retry — or upload an image.
capture.unsupportedHint: This browser cannot open the camera. Upload an image instead.
capture.insecureHint: Open this page over HTTPS or localhost, or upload an image.

gallery.missing: The photo file is missing on the server.
gallery.max: Maximum 10 photos per child per topic.
gallery.maxSize: Photos must be 50 MB or smaller.
gallery.badFormat: Photos must be JPG, JPEG, or PNG and at most 50 MB.
gallery.consentLocked: Gallery is locked until the parent approves.
gallery.indexHint: Pick a child to open their gallery. The group filter narrows the list.
gallery.noChildrenTitle: No children in this session yet
gallery.noChildrenDesc: Add children to this session's groups to start managing the gallery.
gallery.noTopic: This session has no topics yet.
gallery.childNotFound: This child is not in this session.

consent.title: Consent
consent.sendTitle: Send the consent request to {{child}}'s mother on WhatsApp?
consent.urlWhilePending: The link is available while still pending.
consent.selectHint: Select children who still need a consent request.
consent.sendSelectedBody: Each selected child's mother gets a WhatsApp message with their own consent link.
consent.bulkSkipped: {{skipped}} already decided — no WhatsApp message was re-sent.
consent.empty: No children in this session yet.
consent.alreadyDecided: Already {{status}} — the link is unchanged and WhatsApp was not re-sent.

reports.title: Session reports
reports.narrativeReadyBody: Review and edit it before sending to parents.
reports.revokeWarn: The link stops working for everyone immediately.
reports.regenerateWarn: The old link is revoked and a new one becomes active immediately.
reports.batchHint: Pick report rows (max 10 sends per request).
reports.noChildrenTitle: No children in this session yet
reports.noChildrenDesc: Reports are composed per child. Add children to this session's groups first — the batch matrix below fills in once there is anyone to report on.
reports.noTopicTitle: No topic in this session yet
reports.noTopicDesc: Reports follow topics. This session does not have any topics yet.
